 Valencia 0-0 Real Madrid

 DISALLOWED GOAL published at 20 mins 20 mins 
 Valencia 0-0 Real Madrid 
 All Valencia now who have the ball in the net.
 From the corner it's headed clear and then dinked back into the box where the unmarked Guido Rodríguez is on hand to tap in.
 But the Argentina is a yard or so off. The flag goes up.

 GREAT SAVE! published at 19 mins 19 mins 
 Valencia 0-0 Real Madrid 
 Wow, almost 1-0 Valencia. Aurélien Tchouaméni gives the ball away on the edge of his own box to Aaron Mayol who smashes a half-volley towards the top corner and Thibaut Courtois has to tip it over full stretch.

 Post published at 19 mins 19 mins 
 Valencia 0-0 Real Madrid 
 Half a penalty shout, if even that, as César Tárrega shoulder barges Kylian Mbappe off the ball in the box.
 Mbappe hits the deck, the referee says no penalty, and the Valencia fans accuse Mbappe of diving.

 Diomande's on a mission as he glides past two defenders with some cheeky skill. His cross with the outside of his boot is too close to the keeper, though.

 Valencia 0-0 Real Madrid 
 Play is stopped in the ninth minute to allow players and fans to pay tribute to Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel who died after suffering a serious injury during a Spanish second-division match.

 Valencia v Real Madrid (20:00 BST) 
 Image source, Getty Images Only Raphinha (15) has scored more goals in Europe's big-five leagues this season than Real Madrid's Kylian Mbappe (12). The Frenchman has scored hat-tricks in each of his last two La Liga appearances against Valencia.

 Valencia v Real Madrid (20:00 BST) 
 Valencia have failed to reach 10 points after their first 11 LaLiga games for the third consecutive season (nine in the current 2026-27 campaign, nine in 2025-26 and seven in 2024-25) – they had reached this tally in each of their previous 26 top-flight campaigns.

 Post published at 19:51 GMT 19:51 GMT

 So, it looks like Jose Mourinho has made one change to the starting XI that faced Racing Santander last week with Federico Valverde replacing Trent Alexander-Arnold who drops to the bench.
 His former Liverpool team-mate Harvey Elliott is among the Valencia subs.
